proof_body:
by
  intro a l h₀ h
  have h' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖a (n + 1)‖ / ‖a n‖) Filter.atTop (nhds l) := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h
  refine ⟨fun hl => summable_of_ratio_test_tendsto_lt_one hl (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h₀) h', ?_⟩
  rintro hl ⟨S, hS⟩
  have hz : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h₁ := (hS.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).sub hS
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_range_succ] using h₁
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (h.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hl))
  have hmono : ∀ n, N ≤ n → |a N| ≤ |a n| := by
    intro n hn
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact le_rfl
    | succ n hn ih =>
      have h₁ := hN n hn
      have h₂ : 0 < |a n| := abs_pos.2 (h₀ n)
      rw [one_lt_div h₂] at h₁
      exact ih.trans h₁.le
  have h₃ : |a N| ≤ |(0 : ℝ)| := ge_of_tendsto hz.abs (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, hmono⟩)
  have h₄ : 0 < |a N| := abs_pos.2 (h₀ N)
  rw [abs_zero] at h₃
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ), (∀ n, a n ≠ 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |a (n + 1)| / |a n|) Filter.atTop (nhds l) → (l < 1 → Summable a) ∧ (1 < l → ¬ ∃ S : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n) Filter.atTop (nhds S))
